profile_text.body:
Hut 8 Corp. is a public company headquartered in Miami, Florida and traded under the ticker HUT. In its own description, it owns, operates and scales purpose-built businesses that acquire, deploy and monetize specialized hardware for next-generation, energy-intensive technologies, and it says this portfolio gives direct exposure to markets created by transformative technologies such as AI and Bitcoin mining.

The company's site highlights the full commercialization of its 1 GW Beacon Point AI data center campus, citing a second 352 MW IT lease that it says brings campus-level base-term contract value to $19.6 billion.

Its SEC filing identifier is CIK 0001964789. Its recorded litigation exposure is in Florida, with 96 matters. No MCP servers are listed for it.
